Open Dates 2026

By admin | Published September 8, 2026

🎃 Ten nights of frights this Halloween season!
Sinister Sidney will be open Fridays and Saturdays this October (including Halloween!) from 7:30 – 10:00pm, weather permitting.
We are an ages 12+ outdoor haunted attraction so dress appropriately for the weather.
Tickets are $20 at the gate. 🎃

Operation Krampus

By admin | Published November 15, 2025

Sinister Sidney proudly hosts the 1st annual Operation Krampus—a chillingly cheerful effort to support the Fremont County Deputy Association’s Operation Santa. Every toy and cash donation from this event goes directly to the Association once the snow settles.

🎁 Bring a new, unwrapped toy and be entered for a chance to win two 2026 Sinister Sidney tickets.

Enjoy Hot cocoa, reindeer games, and a raffle… you could also get your picture taken with “santa” if you dare!

The more you give, the deeper the magic stirs.

Donations can be brought to the event on December 13.

For questions or more information, reach out to us on Facebook at Sinister Sidney.

🖤 A little scare for a good cause

Where did the month go?

By admin | Published November 2, 2025

Sadly another season has ended, the door is shut, the screams gone silent, and we say thank you to every patron and actor that made this season one of many memorable ones!!

Without any of you, we couldn’t pull this off every year!!!

However, our door may be shut till next season but this definitely is not the last you’ll see of us!!! Big things are cooking for next year!!!

Until then we bid you farewell!!
